propositions: Changing a ticket's type while keeping the plan unchanged causes plan-review to reuse a stale verdict computed under different type-gating criteria instead of re-running the review.

Type gates scoring in four locations in orchestrator.py and workflow_ops.py, making verdicts dependent on ticket_type; a plan passing as bug (exempt) keeps that pass when retyped to task (not exempt), though it should block under the current type's criteria.

Both reuse paths (idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse) in reuse.py compare material fingerprint and base_sha but never check whether stored ticket_type matches current ticket_type before allowing reuse.

The fix reads stored ticket_type from the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar in both reuse paths and declines reuse (returns None) only when both stored and current type are truthy and differ, preserving backward compatibility for pre-change sidecars.
material_fingerprint is deliberately left unchanged to avoid invalidating all existing attestations; the fix adds a new _type_changed predicate checked independently in both reuse functions.
